exclusions.source_text: Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group (ECOG) performance status ≤ 2 (see Appendix A).
Calculated creatinine clearance of ≥ 30 mL/min by Modified Diet in Renal Disease (MDRD) formula or Cockcroft-Gault formula
Spot urine (albumin/creatinine ratios (spot urine) \< 500 mg/g or urine dipstick negative/trace.
Serum bilirubin values \< 1.5 × ULN. Isolated bilirubin ≥ 1.5 × ULN is acceptable if bilirubin is fractionated and direction bilirubin \<35%.
Serum aspartate transaminase (ALT) and/or aspartate transaminase (AST) values \< 2.5 × the upper limit of normal (ULN) of the institutional laboratory reference range.
Pregnancy or lactation or planned lactation (breastfeeding).
Prior history of malignancies, other than MM, unless the patient has completed definitive treatment and has been free of the disease for ≥ 3 years.
Congestive heart failure (New York Heart Association \[NYHA\] Class 3 or 4)
Clinically significant, uncontrolled cardiac arrhythmia such a 2nd degree or 3rd degree atrioventricular block
Recent (within the preceding 6 months) myocardial infarction or stroke
Diabetes mellitus with \> 2 episodes of ketoacidosis in the preceding 12 months
